subject: From Grok: Lisan viseme top-up + jewelry pack v001
body: Two drops are now in From Grok, unpacked. (1) GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002\01_VISEMES top-up from HaL: Z_3 zD1-zD3-src and zE01-zE12, plus Z_2 zF1-zF5 real-photo mouth swaps (CC BY / CC BY-SA credits are in NOTES.md if published). MANIFEST.csv, NOTES.md and SHA256SUMS were updated, and the old ones are kept as *.prev-20261014. Bests are unchanged: 15 = zA, 16 = zC2 or zE07. Shapes 15 and 16 stay CONTROVERSIAL: the generator can't draw a lip bite on any face. Ziggy has been offered a real-bite phone close-up for a mouth swap, or locking both as known defects. (2) cfa_jewelry_product_v001: 24 standalone product shots (Hon Dolo 6, James 13, Lisan 5), review sheets, INDEX, MANIFEST.json and DELIVERY.md, which states the display standard going forward. Wearing examples are held for drift. The HD-CHAIN-A01-D06 round has not been generated yet.
